title: Our intervention areas
subtitle: Five strategic pillars of intervention to foster sustainable inclusion, equal opportunities, and self-reliance for persons with disabilities across the DRC.

protection.title: Rights & Legal advocacy
protection.desc: Promoting and actively defending fundamental human rights, popularizing domestic legislation and international treaties, and combating discrimination and exclusion.
points: Free legal counsel and guidance for persons with disabilities facing rights violations.
Institutional advocacy targeting municipal authorities and legal bodies for policy enforcement.
Community awareness campaigns to eradicate disability-related prejudice and stigma.

accessibility.title: Universal accessibility
accessibility.desc: Advocacy and concrete interventions for physical accessibility across public buildings, roads, public transit, and inclusive communication channels.
points: Architectural accessibility audits of partner schools, clinics, and municipal facilities.
Installation and renovation of access ramps, widened entryways, and adapted restrooms.
Promoting digital accessibility and adapted communication materials for all disabilities.

education.title: Inclusive education & Training
education.desc: School enrollment of children and youth with disabilities, educator training in inclusive pedagogy, and distribution of tailored learning materials.
points: Inclusive enrollment and educational scholarships for vulnerable children with disabilities.
Teacher training in differentiated learning methodologies and inclusive classroom management.
Provision of specialized didactic materials (Braille, tactile supplies, and adapted textbooks).

health.title: Health, Rehabilitation & Mobility aids
health.desc: Healthcare support, physical and functional rehabilitation, psychosocial accompaniment, and provision of assistive devices and mobility aids.
points: Distribution of orthopedic devices, hand-pedaled tricycles, crutches, and adapted wheelchairs.
Regular physical therapy sessions and personalized psychosocial counseling.
Medical referral pathways for specialized clinical treatments and rehabilitation care.

empowerment.title: Socio-economic empowerment
empowerment.desc: Vocational skills training, entrepreneurship coaching, support for income-generating activities, and long-term socio-professional integration.
points: Practical vocational workshops in viable trades (tailoring, crafts, shoe repair, digital skills).
Starter toolkits and seed micro-grants for autonomous income-generating activities.
Career mentoring and private-sector advocacy for inclusive recruitment practices.
